children: Bajaj Finance Limited (NSE:BAJFINANCE) saw shares rally after the board approved a Rs17,500–18,000 crore raise (QIP and promoter warrants), strong Q2 AUM and customer growth, higher deposit rates, a bond reissue, and a Buy initiation from Jefferies with a Rs1,280 target.
: BAJFINANCE board approved a Rs 17,500–18,000 crore raise: up to Rs 11,700 crore via QIP and up to Rs 5,800 crore via promoter convertible warrants; stock rallied ~2%–4.6% intraday.
: BAJFINANCE Q2 AUM ₹5.85tn (+26.5% YoY); AUM rose ₹37,800cr in Jul–Sep. New loans 13.45M (+11% YoY). Customer base 128.85M. Deposits ₹69,750cr. Stock +4.6% post-AUM.
: Bajaj Finance (BAJFINANCE) raised fixed-deposit rates Oct 7: 12–60m tenures up 15–40 bps. Top regular rate 7.75% for 31–60m; senior bonus now +40 bps (up to 8.15%).
: Bajaj Finance (BAJFINANCE) invited bids for a reissue of 7.78% Nov 2029 bonds targeting ₹20bn; accepted ₹5.10bn at a proposed 8.20% yield.
: Jefferies initiated and kept a Buy on Bajaj Finance (BAJFINANCE) with a Rs1,280 target, citing 23% loan growth assumptions and possible Bajaj Housing Finance stake monetization.
: Bajaj Finance (BAJFINANCE) jumped about 2.8% intraday after company announcements, reflecting immediate market reaction and a roughly 2.8% gain from prior levels.
